# Components panel API

<!-- Generated by config/scripts/generate-plugin-authoring-skill-references.mjs. Do not edit. -->

Everything a components panel (`"ui": "components"`) imports comes from `orca`. Components are JSX tags only; props are semantic (no `className`, `style` or lowercase DOM tags). Event props are functions. An unknown prop or enum value is dropped with a warning; an unknown component draws a placeholder.

## Prop vocabulary

- `Gap`: `'none' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`
- `Align`: `'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'stretch'`
- `Tone`: `'neutral' | 'accent' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'`
- `Size`: `'xs' | 'sm' | 'md'`
- `Variant`: `'solid' | 'outline' | 'ghost'`
- `Press`: `() => unknown`
- `IconName`: activity, bar-chart-3, bell, blocks, book, bot, bug, calendar, cloud, code, database, file-text, flag, folder, gauge, globe, hammer, layers, lightbulb, package, plug, puzzle, rocket, star, terminal, wrench, zap, add, remove, delete, edit, refresh, search, settings, check, close, info, warning, error, open-external, copy, download, upload, play, pause, stop, more, expand, collapse, next, filter, branch, file, agent, link. Any other name draws a fallback glyph.

## Components

- `Stack` (children: any): `gap?: Gap; align?: Align`
- `Row` (children: any): `gap?: Gap; align?: Align; justify?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end' | 'between'; wrap?: boolean`
- `Text` (children: text, Text, Link, Code, Badge, RelativeTime): `tone?: Tone; muted?: boolean; size?: Size; weight?: 'regular' | 'medium' | 'semibold'; truncate?: boolean`
- `Heading` (children: text, Text, Link, Code, Badge, RelativeTime): `level?: 1 | 2 | 3`
- `Button` (children: text): `variant?: Variant; tone?: Tone; size?: Size; icon?: IconName; tooltip?: string; disabled?: boolean; onPress?: Press`
- `IconButton` (children: none): `icon: IconName; label: string; tooltip?: string; variant?: Variant; tone?: Tone; size?: Size; disabled?: boolean; onPress?: Press`
- `Badge` (children: text): `tone?: Tone`
- `Card` (children: any): `title?: string; description?: string`
- `List` (children: ListItem only): `label?: string`
- `ListItem` (children: any): `title?: string; description?: string; icon?: IconName; current?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onPress?: Press`
- `Input` (children: none): `label: string; labelHidden?: boolean; value?: string; defaultValue?: string; placeholder?: string; type?: 'text' | 'search' | 'password'; maxLength?: number; invalid?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange?: (value: string) => void; onSubmit?: (value: string) => void`
- `Switch` (children: none): `label: string; checked?: boolean; defaultChecked?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void`
- `Select` (children: none): `label: string; labelHidden?: boolean; value?: string; defaultValue?: string; placeholder?: string; options: readonly { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]; disabled?: boolean; onChange?: (value: string) => void`
- `Separator` (children: none): `orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'`
- `Progress` (children: none): `label: string; labelHidden?: boolean; value?: number`
- `Spinner` (children: none): `label: string; labelHidden?: boolean`
- `EmptyState` (children: any): `title: string; description?: string; icon?: IconName`
- `Link` (children: text): `href?: string; onPress?: Press`
- `Code` (children: text): `block?: boolean`
- `Textarea` (children: none): `label: string; labelHidden?: boolean; value?: string; defaultValue?: string; placeholder?: string; rows?: number; maxLength?: number; invalid?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange?: (value: string) => void; onSubmit?: (value: string) => void`
- `Checkbox` (children: none): `label: string; description?: string; checked?: boolean; defaultChecked?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange?: (checked: boolean) => void`
- `RadioGroup` (children: none): `label: string; labelHidden?: boolean; value?: string; defaultValue?: string; options: readonly RadioOption[]; orientation?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal'; disabled?: boolean; onChange?: (value: string) => void`
- `Slider` (children: none): `label: string; labelHidden?: boolean; value?: number; defaultValue?: number; min?: number; max?: number; step?: number; showValue?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange?: (value: number) => void`
- `Field` (children: any): `label: string; description?: string; error?: string; required?: boolean`
- `Tabs` (children: Tab only): `label: string; value?: string; defaultValue?: string; onChange?: (value: string) => void`
- `Tab` (children: any): `value: string; label: string; icon?: IconName; disabled?: boolean`
- `Collapsible` (children: any): `title: string; description?: string; open?: boolean; defaultOpen?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; onChange?: (open: boolean) => void`
- `Toolbar` (children: any): `label: string; gap?: Gap`
- `Grid` (children: any): `columns?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6; minItemWidth?: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'; gap?: Gap`
- `Table` (children: none): `label: string; columns: readonly TableColumn[]; rows: readonly TableRow[]; sort?: TableSort; selectionMode?: 'none' | 'single' | 'multiple'; selected?: readonly string[]; defaultSelected?: readonly string[]; hasMore?: boolean; loading?: boolean; emptyText?: string; maxHeight?: MaxHeight; onSortChange?: (sort: TableSort) => void; onSelectionChange?: (selection: { keys: string[] }) => void; onRowAction?: (row: { key: string }) => void; onLoadMore?: () => void`
- `Tree` (children: none): `label: string; items: readonly TreeItem[]; selected?: string; defaultSelected?: string; expanded?: readonly string[]; defaultExpanded?: readonly string[]; maxHeight?: MaxHeight; onSelect?: (item: { key: string }) => void; onToggle?: (item: { key: string; expanded: boolean }) => void; onAction?: (item: { key: string }) => void`
- `Markdown` (children: none): `content: string`
- `CodeView` (children: none): `code: string; language?: string; label?: string; lineNumbers?: boolean; wrap?: boolean; maxHeight?: MaxHeight`
- `Image` (children: none): `src: string; alt: string; size?: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'full'; fit?: 'contain' | 'cover'; rounded?: boolean`
- `KeyValue` (children: none): `label?: string; items: readonly KeyValueItem[]`
- `Callout` (children: any): `tone?: Tone; title?: string; icon?: IconName`
- `Skeleton` (children: none): `shape?: 'text' | 'block' | 'circle'; lines?: number; label?: string`
- `RelativeTime` (children: none): `at: number; format?: RelativeTimeFormat; tone?: Tone; muted?: boolean`

## Runtime

- `h(type: unknown, props: object | null, ...children: OrcaNode[]): OrcaElement`
- `atom<T>(initial: T): Atom<T>`: State for this panel run.
- `atom<T>(key: string, initial: T, options?: AtomOptions<T>): Atom<T>`: Named state, unique per plugin, optionally persisted.
- `derived<T>(compute: () => T): ReadonlyAtom<T>`: Computed from other atoms; reading it while rendering subscribes to what it reads.
- `read<T>(atom: ReadonlyAtom<T>): T`
- `set<T>(atom: Atom<T>, value: T): void`: Stores `value` as is (functions included). Batched; throws while rendering.
- `update<T>(atom: Atom<T>, updater: (previous: T) => T): void`: Replaces the value with `updater(previous)`. Batched; throws while rendering.
- `mount(component: () => OrcaNode): void`: Optional: the module's default export is mounted automatically.
- `on<E extends keyof OrcaEvents>(event: E, handler: (payload: OrcaEvents[E]) => void): Disposable`
- `host.call(method, ...args)`
- `host.has(method: string)`: Whether this Orca offers `method` to this panel.
- `api: { readonly major: number; readonly minor: number }`: The host API this Orca implements.
- `env.locale: string`: Orca's UI language (BCP-47).
- `env.theme: Theme`: Reading it while rendering re-renders on light/dark switches.
- `env.client: 'desktop'`
- `ui.catalog: number`: Grows with the component catalog.
- `ui.has(component: string, prop?: string)`: Whether this Orca draws `component` (and accepts `prop` on it, when given).
- `shell.openExternal(url: string)`: Needs a press on one of the panel's controls; see "User gestures".
- `files.saveAs(options: HostMethods['files.saveAs']['params'])`: Needs a press on one of the panel's controls; see "User gestures".
- `plugin: PluginBridgeApi`
- `storage: StorageApi`
- `settings: SettingsApi`
- `secrets: SecretsApi`

## Panel ↔ worker contract

Declare requests and worker posts once with declaration merging, in a file both the panel and the worker include: `declare module 'orca' { interface PluginRequests { 'todos.list': { input: { done?: boolean }; output: Todo[] } } interface PluginPanelEvents { 'todos.changed': { count: number } } }`. Declared names are typed end to end (`plugin.request`, `plugin.on`, the worker's `orca.panels.handle` and `orca.panels.post`, and `orca/testing`'s `requests` and `panel.post`); any other name carries JSON.

## Types

- `PersistScope = 'memory' | 'plugin' | 'workspace' | 'storage'`: Where a keyed atom survives: this panel run, every run of the plugin, per workspace, or the plugin's own storage under the atom's key (`storage:own`), shared with its worker and other panels and kept current when they change it.
- `AtomOptions<T> = { persist?: PersistScope; version?: number; migrate?: (stored: JsonValue, fromVersion: number) => T }`
- `PanelContext = { subscriptions: Disposable[]; signal: AbortSignal; visible: ReadonlyAtom<boolean>; panel: { id: string } }`: Passed to the module's optional `export function setup(ctx)`.
- `PanelSetup = (ctx: PanelContext) => void | (() => void)`: Runs once, after persisted atoms load and before the first render.
- `HostError = Error & { code: string; retryable: boolean; retryAfterMs?: number }`: Rejections carry a `code` (`not_permitted`, `capability_denied`, `timeout`, ...).
- `PluginRequestOptions = { signal?: AbortSignal; timeoutMs?: number }`: `timeoutMs` (at most 120000, default 30000) is how long the worker may take.
- `PluginBridgeApi = { request<K extends keyof PluginRequests>(name: K, ...args: PluginRequestArgs<K>): Promise<PluginRequestOutput<K>>; request<N extends string>(name: Undeclared<N, PluginRequests>, input?: JsonValue, options?: PluginRequestOptions): Promise<JsonValue>; on<K extends keyof PluginPanelEvents>(event: K, handler: (payload: PluginPanelEvents[K]) => void): Disposable; on<N extends string>(event: Undeclared<N, PluginPanelEvents>, handler: (payload: JsonValue) => void): Disposable }`: Your plugin's own worker.
- `DataChange = { key: string }`: A key someone (you, another panel, the worker or the person in Settings) changed.
- `StorageApi = { get(key: string): Promise<JsonValue | null>; set(key: string, value: JsonValue): Promise<void>; delete(key: string): Promise<void>; keys(): Promise<string[]>; onDidChange(listener: (change: DataChange) => void): Disposable }`: The plugin's own JSON store (`storage:own`), the same one its worker uses.
- `SettingsApi = { get(): Promise<Record<string, JsonValue>>; get(key: string): Promise<JsonValue | undefined>; set(key: string, value: JsonValue): Promise<void>; onDidChange(listener: (change: DataChange) => void): Disposable }`: The plugin's settings (`settings:own`): those it declares in `contributes.settings` read as their `default` until the person changes them in Settings.
- `SecretsApi = { get(key: string): Promise<string | null>; set(key: string, value: string): Promise<void>; delete(key: string): Promise<void> }`: The plugin's encrypted secrets (`secrets:own`).

## Limits

A render is refused, keeping the last good one, past 5000 nodes, depth 64, 512 KiB of data, 16 KiB per text, 1 KiB per label prop, 32 props per node or 500 Select options.
